conviction.explanation: Consistent with the wait-oriented research verdict: profitable growth is counterbalanced by two negative FCF quarters, capex and dilution. The post-earnings gap invalidates treating regular-close technical references as executable overnight levels.

executive_summary:
Alphabet Q3 revenue grew 25%, operating income grew 30%, and Cloud operating profit reached $11.121bn. These support a viable long-term AI growth thesis and separate core operations from investment-loss-driven EPS volatility. TTM FCF remains positive at $19.747bn.

Recent common-shareholder economics are weaker: Q3 FCF was negative $9.065bn after negative $5.855bn in Q2, with $51.355bn quarterly capex and $12.371bn common issuance. The research verdict favors waiting before adding, rather than asserting the business has failed. A roughly 10% after-hours decline does not establish fair value; daily indicators use the regular close and omit the gap, so their historical support is not an executable current floor.
bull_case: Revenue, operating income and Cloud profitability are growing rapidly, with positive TTM FCF supporting eventual monetization of the AI investment cycle.
bear_case: Two negative FCF quarters, heavy capex, common issuance and the post-earnings gap undermine an immediate add; positive operations do not prove per-share capital returns.
key_uncertainties: Timing and magnitude of per-share cash-flow recovery.
Post-gap technical structure and defensible fair value.
Validated recurring-earnings valuation excluding investment distortions.
A daily OHLC bar incorporating the post-earnings gap.
Complete current debt disaggregation and per-share investment-return assessment.
catalysts_upcoming: Next quarterly cash statement showing whether FCF turns positive and TTM cash rebuilds.
Next share-count and financing disclosures showing the interaction of issuance, repurchases, stock compensation and diluted shares.
A complete daily bar incorporating the earnings gap will provide a relevant technical snapshot; it will not itself prove fair value.

action_plan.note: Signal too mixed for precise levels (conviction +0.00, convergence 0.45). Wait for a clearer setup.

research_verdict.thesis: The bear carries the decision against an immediate add because current owner-cash economics weakened despite strong operating growth. Two negative FCF quarters and common issuance make a lower quote insufficient buying evidence. This is a wait ruling, not a conclusion that the long-term business has failed.
research_verdict.strongest_counterexample: Revenue grew 25%, operating income grew 30%, Cloud operating profit reached $11.121bn and TTM FCF remains positive at $19.747bn; this may be productive investment rather than permanent deterioration.
invalidation_conditions: Two subsequent quarters of positive FCF accompanied by no net common-share issuance would undermine the current cash-and-dilution basis for waiting.
Reported TTM FCF at or below zero would invalidate treating current pressure as compatible with a still-positive trailing cash foundation and require a stronger adverse reassessment.

A daily OHLC bar incorporating the post-earnings gap.
Complete current debt disaggregation and per-share investment-return assessment.

Cloud operating profit is real operating evidence.
